maya: Quick check-in for EdgeSwarm onramp — partner wants a 2-week sandbox POC starting next Monday. Main asks: staging tenant provisioning, VPC peering steps, pricing for a small reserved commit, and whether we can support partner-managed HSM. cc @jonas
serena: Heard — timeline makes sense. They want demo traffic (bursty) up to ~200 rps for short periods. Also sent a security questionnaire asking about SOC2, data residency, and KMS options.
jonas: We can get a staging tenant live in ~48h once we have partner org name + billing contact and CIDR for peering. Network notes: inbound on 443, outbound via NAT to partner analytics is allowed but needs CIDR + ports. On-prem HSM requires Redwood Private; we can do KMS cross-account for hosted.
rachel: Pricing note from sales: partner expects a blended co-sell discount. For POC we should offer trial credits; for reserved commit they'd prefer a monthly seat-based minimum. I can draft a quote if you confirm the baseline throughput.
maya: For the POC baseline, use 4 vGPU concurrency ~8k tok/session estimate. @jonas can you run a quick unit cost calc with Optimize numbers? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
jonas: Yep. Rough run: hosted unit cost w/ 4 vGPU pool ~ $0.004/token backend (ballpark). I'll run a more precise calc and push to the shared sheet. Also: partner needs service-keys scoped to their tenant — we should enable tenant-level key creation.
ops-oncall: Telemetry/observability: we'll need a read-only S3 bucket or cross-account role for their analytics. Ensure we mask request payloads per our PII policy. Also add a retention note — 90 days default, ops can extend if they contract extra retention.
serena: Security questionnaire: we'll send SOC2 and our data residency page. For EU residency we can host in eu-west-1; if partner wants logs exported to their US lake that's allowed but must be consented in the DPA. I'll draft the sec answers.
maya: Can someone post the minimal test curl we want them to run to validate routing? We'll include expected response to speed validation.
jonas: Paste this to test routing (replace <TOKEN>):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rw-medium","input":"ping","max_tokens":4}'
```
Expected quick success snippet: {"id":"...","status":"succeeded","output":"pong"}
maya: Scheduling 30-min runbook Thurs 10am PT. Agenda: 1) tenant provisioning, 2) run tests, 3) networking walkthrough, 4) pricing + next steps. Who can join?
rachel: I can do pricing.
serena: I'll lead security Qs and send the draft answers before the runbook.
jonas: I'll join for infra and provisioning. I'll also create the provisioning ticket now.
deploy-bot: Provisioning ticket created INC-4521 and assigned to jonas.
maya: Action items: jonas — cost calc + create tenant ticket (INC-4521). serena — sec questionnaire draft + SOC2. rachel — draft co-sell quote. I'll coordinate time with partner and send calendar invite. Anything else? :white_check_mark:
